title: Equip More Spells
description: A multi-armed robed sorcerer with a crown and goggles kneels atop a mound of treasures, casting a glowing spell from a lantern while holding scrolls and a staff topped with a bee-like insect. Ethereal hooded figures float in the background around a dark silhouette amid swirling magical particles and coins.
prompt: A multi-armed sorcerer wearing a crown and round goggles, dressed in ornate robes covered with magical symbols, kneels on a large pile of treasure and coins. He holds multiple scrolls, a staff with a large bee-like insect on top, and casts a glowing spell from a lantern. Ethereal hooded figures float in the smoky background around a dark silhouetted figure, with magical golden particles and orbs floating throughout the scene, dark fantasy ink illustration style
